page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of an opening) with running text in one column; a bracketed diagram of divisions set within the text; a catchword-style signature at the foot. Left edge shows part of the facing left page (fragments of text and braces at the margin, not transcribed as main text). Margin notes: none on this page's own column.

main_text.p: Figura erat præter communem prædictam generaliter, {Generalis.} Leu.26.11. {Specialis.}
Generalis, erat totius ecclesiæ catholicæ in Christo fabricatæ. Apoc.13.6. & 21.3. cum 2.Cor.6.15. & Eph.2.21. comparatis inter se.
main_text.l: Specialis erat, Prima, quæ ecclesiam particularem figurabat Num.9.18.19. cum Ephe.4.4.5.
Secunda, vnumquemque Christianum verum. Leuit. 26.11.2. Cor.6.15.
main_text.p: Materia communis erat, aurum, argentum, æs, hyacinthia, purpurea, coccinea, diabapha, siue linum xylinum, siue lana caprarum, pelles etiam arietum rubefactæ, & melium, & ligna shittim, ex voluntaria populi oblatione, vsq; dum satis esset cum abundantia.Exod.25.1.2.3.4.5.& 36.4.5.6.
Huius æquitas perpetua erat, vt sufficientiam quæ tamen nullo modo excederet ad thesaurum Dei dicarent.Neh.10.32.2.Cor.9.8.

page.notes: The diagram in the centre (Generalis/Specialis, Prima/Secunda, Causae, Inhaerentes) is set in braces; its box-by-box layout is only approximated above. Left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are omitted. Some words in the diagrams are doubtful, notably "melium" and "shittim", and the Greek-like terms "diabapha" and "hyacinthia" as printed.
